meta.description: Stable parts (exact enumeration of fixed points of h ∝ (Sigma h - theta)_+ with the stability test 'h is the top eigenvector of (Sigma - theta 11^T)_SS and strict off-support inequality') vs. clusters populated by the network.
meta.cluster_def: average-linkage on L1 distance between embeddings, cut at 0.1 (K_tol gives cuts 0.05, 0.2); clusters made only of dead neurons (all I-B weights at floor) excluded
meta.match_def: learned centroid matched to a stable part if cosine > 0.98

fields.n_stable: number of stable parts (function of Sigma and theta only)
fields.matched_frac: fraction of neurons in clusters matching a stable part
fields.max_cos_eig: max |cos| between part and any single eigenvector of Sigma
fields.span_topK: fraction of the part's norm inside the top-K eigenspace of Sigma, K = n_stable
fields.cos_restricted_perron: cos between part and Perron vector of Sigma restricted to the part's support

block12.desc: 3 blocks of 4, within corr 0.5, across 0.1, unit variance

powerlaw12.desc: random rotation of spectrum k^-1, B=12 (signed correlations), trace=B

powerlaw_pos12.desc: nonnegative sparse factor model, factor variances k^-1, B=12, trace=B
